jobs.title: Creative Director - Wellness & Lifestyle
jobs.description:
Location: Barcelona

About Us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.
We bridge digital and creative thinking, developing innovative work across skincare, healthcare, fashion, lifestyle, FMCG, and more. Our international teams in the US and Barcelona deliver results through smart strategy, sharp creativity, and meticulous execution.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Creative Director with strong conceptual thinking, great visual taste and experience working across global wellness and lifestyle brands.
Someone who can move comfortably between product and lifestyle, science and culture, and who understands how creative needs to work across the full consumer journey.
You might be working on a product with a complex ingredient or efficacy story one day, developing a talent-led campaign the next, and figuring out how that same brand idea translates into more product-focused or conversion-driven work further down the funnel.
This is a global role, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable developing ideas that can travel across markets and cultures without becoming generic.
You’ll lead creative development across global wellness, beauty-adjacent and lifestyle brands, from early concepts and campaign platforms through to production and execution.
We’re looking for someone who cares about the idea as much as the craft, but also understands what the creative is there to do.
You’ll work hand in hand with Strategy, as well as Copy, Design, Social and Production, to understand the audience, cultural context, role of each channel and each stage of the funnel, and translate that thinking into strong creative.
This isn’t purely an art direction role. You need to be able to come up with strong campaign ideas, build on other people’s ideas and turn them into something bigger.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong global campaign ideas and creative platforms that can live across markets, channels and executions.
Partner closely with strategists from the beginning of the process, challenging and building on briefs rather than simply receiving them.
Understand the role creative plays across the full funnel, from building awareness and brand desire to communicating product benefits, driving consideration and supporting conversion.
Know when an execution needs to build the brand, when it needs to explain the product and when it simply needs to make someone want it.
Turn strategy, product benefits and consumer insights into simple, relevant creative ideas.
Build global creative platforms that have a clear central idea while leaving enough room for markets to make them culturally relevant.
Lead the visual direction of brands across product, lifestyle, talent and culture-led work.
Find interesting ways to communicate ingredients, efficacy, innovation and science without everything suddenly looking clinical.
Make products feel desirable through photography, film, CGI, design, casting, styling and storytelling.
Bring product and lifestyle together naturally, rather than creating a beautiful lifestyle campaign and remembering the product at the end.
Develop ideas around talent, creators, partnerships and cultural moments that make sense for the brand and the market.
Think beyond traditional campaign formats and identify opportunities across social, experiences, collaborations, entertainment and emerging culture.
Lead work from concept through production, keeping the original idea and level of craft intact along the way.
Present and sell creative thinking to senior clients and stakeholders across different markets.
Lead and develop multidisciplinary and international creative teams.

What we’re looking for

A Creative Director who is conceptually strong and visually sophisticated, with a portfolio that shows range.
Big campaign thinking
Ideas with a clear point of view that can become genuine global platforms, not just a collection of executions.
Strong visual taste
A great eye for photography, film, casting, styling, design and contemporary brand aesthetics.
Product storytelling
Experience making products, ingredients, technology or benefits interesting and desirable, especially when there’s real science or efficacy behind them.
Full-funnel creative thinking
An understanding of how people move from discovering a brand to considering and buying it, and how the creative job changes along the way.
Strong creative + strategy partnership
Someone who likes working closely with strategists, has a point of view on the brief and knows how to turn strategic thinking into creative opportunities.
Global thinking
Experience developing work for multiple markets and understanding the difference between a global idea and simply making the same campaign appear everywhere. You should be comfortable collaborating with local teams and adapting ideas around different cultural behaviors and audiences without losing the core creative thought.
Lifestyle and culture
Work that shows an understanding of how brands can play in culture through talent, creators, collaborations, social, entertainment and experiences.
Range
We want someone who can create a beautiful product or efficacy story and then switch gears into a culturally relevant lifestyle campaign without either feeling forced.

Key Requirements

10+ years of creative experience, ideally across agencies and/or ambitious consumer brands.
Significant experience working on global brands and international campaigns.
Experience leading integrated and full-funnel campaigns, from brand-building through product and conversion-focused creative.
Background in wellness, beauty, personal care, lifestyle, premium CPG or adjacent categories.
Experience working closely with Strategy on audiences, consumer journeys, cultural insights and creative briefs.
Experience working with product claims, ingredients, efficacy or science-led briefs is a plus.
Strong photography and film production experience.
Experience working with talent, creators or culturally driven campaigns.
Experience leading multidisciplinary and international creative teams.
Excellent client-facing and presentation skills.
Native or near-native English, or equivalent professional fluency developed through extensive experience working in English. This person needs to be able to concept, debate, present and sell creative ideas confidently in English with senior global clients and teams.

Portfolio

We want to see ideas, taste and range.
Showcase strong campaigns, as well as activations, social ideas, collaborations and product experiences that demonstrate different ways brands can connect with people.
We want to see work that feels relevant to its audience, where the product matters and the visual execution is strong.

Languages

English (mandatory)
Spanish (preferably)
Any other languages are a plus.

What we offer

Remote flex Fridays from 9:00 AM to 2.30 PM.
Three weeks of remote work per year.
Summer working hours across July and August (9:00 AM to 4.00 PM).
Free English & Spanish classes to boost your global communication skills.
Access to Wellhub, a wellness platform offering a wide range of fitness and wellbeing options.
Flexible retribution plan for meals, transport and childcare.
Holidays: 22 working days + 3 days established by the collective agreement + national and local public holidays.
Bright, spacious offices in the heart of Barcelona.
Competitive salary with real growth opportunities.
A global environment, cutting-edge tools, and a culture driven by trends and innovation.

At Dragons Group, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and strive to build an environment where every individual feels empowered and respected.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist & Producer - Consumer
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

The opportunity

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.
Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers.
Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process.
Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp.
Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast.
Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response.
React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself.
Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea.
Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

What You Bring

5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.
A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed.
A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction.
Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated.
A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it.
A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.
Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas.
A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.
Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.
Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Charlie Oscar isn't a typical agency. We're independent, AI-native, and built to help ambitious brands outmanoeuvre, outpace and outgrow the competition.

We hire for attitude and culture add first - not just experience. Curious, ambitious people who challenge how things are done, bring fresh ideas, and help shape the future of marketing.

Sound like your kind of place?

WHO WE HIRE

If you're already using AI to work smarter, even better.

AI

To have an up to date and forward looking perspective on social-first creative, and be a thought leader in digital advertising creative.
Support new business pitches by providing creative strategic input and developing concepts that showcase our expertise.
Build a team and network of partners, including designers, copywriters, and content creators, to bring ideas to life.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Proven experience in a creative strategy role within a digital or social agency.
Deep expertise in digital and social media platforms, trends, and best practices.
A brilliant creative storyteller with a track record of developing compelling campaigns.
A strategic thinker who can connect creativity with business impact.
Experience working with performance marketing teams to develop high-performing content.
A strong understanding of brand positioning and audience insights.

jobs.description:
About LADbible Group

LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month. With a powerhouse portfolio across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands include LADbible, SPORTbible and Betches.

LADbible’s Commercial Team, LAD360, is a powerhouse of creativity, strategy, and innovation - partnering with the world’s most iconic brands, from Google and Nike to Disney and Tesco. With a headcount of 150 and growing, LAD360 has rapidly become one of the most formidable forces in media, delivering culture-shaping campaigns. Our work has earned us top industry accolades, including Commercial Team of the Year at the 2025 Campaign UK Awards
and Media Brand of the Year at the 2024 MediaWeek Awards
. At the heart of it all is a relentless drive to push boundaries, tell bold stories, and connect brands to youth culture like no one else can.

About the Role

Due to continued business growth and wins, we are expanding the Creative team even further! We’re looking for a conceptual Senior Creative to lead the creative ideation, strategy and execution for our branded pitches and campaigns. It’s an opportunity that requires excellent creative skills and an in-depth understanding of youth culture to be able to run the process from end to end, whilst also demonstrating commercial awareness and our ways of working at LADbible Group.

What the opportunity looks like

Lead projects from briefing to delivery, working with the rest of the creative team
Develop strong social-first ideas and challenge briefs and strategies where necessary
Be a content specialist, understanding the roles and production constraints of different content types (especially video) on social platforms
Specialise in social-led activations but be familiar with creating integrated campaigns, with an understanding of how to use everything from OOH to experiential in your campaign strategies
Communicate and champion creative thinking and technical execution to clients throughout each project
Oversee junior project teams to help them deliver their best work
Be a detail-oriented senior when it comes to approving work with overall accountability
Understand how to brief craft specialists: Animators, Designers, Directors, Talent etc. to deliver projects against your creative vision

Skills and experience we’d like you to have

Senior level creative experience in a social-led creative, marketing or advertising environment
Practical craft skills as well as conceptual thinking
Experience in a fast-paced, quick turnaround environment
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Understanding of how budgets work, scope of work and realistic deliverables
Deep understanding of the role that video/social content plays in every project
Proven track record delivering creatively and commercially successful projects
Experience overseeing teams
Interest in youth culture, pop cultures and social good
Ability to design pitch presentations in Keynote, PowerPoint, Google slides etc.

jobs.description:
Karla Otto is a globally recognized public relations and communications agency, founded in 1982, with offices in 15 key cities across the UK, EMEA, US, and Asia. With a strong presence in fashion capitals such as Milan, London, Paris, and New York, the agency has built a reputation for representing some of the most prestigious names in fashion, beauty, and lifestyle.

In 2017, Karla Otto merged with K2 to form THE INDEPENDENTS, a global marketing, design, and communications group. This collective brings together industry leaders who share a commitment to innovation, excellence, and thoughtful collaboration across the luxury and lifestyle sectors.

At Karla Otto, our team of expert strategists, designers, planners and publicists are dedicated to delivering exceptional results and establishing long-term partnerships with our clients. We are passionate about the world of fashion, beauty, and luxury, with everyone bringing their unique expertise and insights to the table. We are driven by a shared commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the ever-evolving industry landscape.

The Senior Strategist is a senior member of Karla Otto’s Creative Strategy division, working across UK client teams, selected global clients and new business. The role combines creative strategy, cultural insight and concept development across fashion, beauty, lifestyle, hospitality and FMCG.

Working closely with the Creative Strategy leadership team, the Senior Strategist translates strategic direction into clear, compelling ideas and platforms across campaigns, content, experiences and programming. They will lead client briefs and presentations, develop creative-led work and contribute to new business and the continued growth of the Creative Strategy offer.

Cultural fluency is central to the role. The Senior Strategist brings a strong understanding of the creative and cultural landscape, alongside the network and judgement to identify relevant talent, creators, partners and collaborators and translate emerging cultural shifts into original, future-facing ideas.

This is a senior, client-facing role for an ideas-led creative with strong conceptual judgement, cultural intelligence and an active industry network. The role also offers opportunities to develop commercial and team leadership skills, with scope to progress to Director based on demonstrated readiness.

Key Responsibilities

CREATIVE

Lead creative strategy and concept development on assigned UK client briefs, from identifying the opportunity through to campaigns, content, experiences and programming, alongside selected global clients and pitches.
Translate cultural and creative shifts into original thinking for client work and new business.
Lead the creative direction and quality of assigned work, aligning with the Director on strategic direction and the SVP on departmental standards.
Develop the strategic foundation for creative-led briefs and partner with the Director where broader brand or business strategy is required.
Identify and shape experience-led and Insights-led opportunities in partnership with Special Projects and Insights respectively.
Identify and recommend talent, creators, partners and collaborators, working with the Talent team where relevant.
Lead client conversations, presenting and defending strategic and creative recommendations and identifying opportunities to develop the work.

NEW BUSINESS & GROWTH

Lead the creative response on assigned UK and relevant global pitches, with strategic and commercial guidance from the Director and SVP.
Identify opportunities across existing clients and new prospects, and develop and sell Creative Strategy work alongside the senior team.
Build integrated proposals with Insights, Communications, Talent, Beauty, Strategy, Special Projects and other divisions.
Contribute to scoping and pricing, accounting for resourcing, production requirements and profitability, with final commercial approval from the senior team.

TEAM & DIVISION DEVELOPMENT

Coordinate workflow and delivery on assigned briefs, identify resource needs and flag scope or budget pressures to the Director and SVP.
Guide colleagues and external collaborators, giving clear creative feedback and supporting the development of junior team members.
Maintain and grow the external creative network required to deliver work at the right standard.

KEY ATTRIBUTES

6–8 years’ experience in creative strategy, creative direction or an equivalent agency role, with a focus on social and digital channels, programming and experiential work.
A strong portfolio spanning campaigns, content, experiences, programming and brand platforms.
Strong creative problem-solving and conceptual thinking, with a highly developed visual eye and excellent art direction judgement.
Deep reference knowledge across fashion, art, design, music, film and photography, with the instinct to spot what is emerging, anticipate where culture is moving and translate this into original creative thinking.
An active network across talent, creators and the wider creative industries, with a strong understanding of who and what is shaping culture now and next.
Ability to translate strategy into clear, compelling creative ideas, communicate them through strong writing, visual storytelling and presentations, and guide their execution within agreed budgets.
Strong knowledge of creative platforms, partners and production models, including how to commission, brief, scope and price creative work.
Proven ability to present, sell and defend creative work.
Able to move quickly across multiple briefs while maintaining a high creative standard and adapting to different senior stakeholders and working styles.
Experience leading creative and project teams, directing external collaborators and giving clear creative feedback.
Naturally curious and eager to learn, keeping pace with industry changes and exploring how emerging tools and technologies, including AI, can strengthen creative thinking and open up new opportunities for clients.
Strong proficiency in Keynote; working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite advantageous.
Commercial awareness and experience working with budgets, resources and delivery processes, with the ambition to develop broader leadership responsibility.

The London Creative Hub is looking for a Design Technologist to join our studio team and drive innovation in how we create visual content at scale. Push Deel to do things competitors wouldn’t.

Highly organised, hands-on and able to move at speed.

Location: Barcelona

About Us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.
We bridge digital and creative thinking, developing innovative work across skincare, healthcare, fashion, lifestyle, FMCG, and more. Our international teams in the US and Barcelona deliver results through smart strategy, sharp creativity, and meticulous execution.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Creative Director with strong conceptual thinking, great visual taste and experience working across global wellness and lifestyle brands.
Someone who can move comfortably between product and lifestyle, science and culture, and who understands how creative needs to work across the full consumer journey.
You might be working on a product with a complex ingredient or efficacy story one day, developing a talent-led campaign the next, and figuring out how that same brand idea translates into more product-focused or conversion-driven work further down the funnel.
This is a global role, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable developing ideas that can travel across markets and cultures without becoming generic.
You’ll lead creative development across global wellness, beauty-adjacent and lifestyle brands, from early concepts and campaign platforms through to production and execution.
We’re looking for someone who cares about the idea as much as the craft, but also understands what the creative is there to do.
You’ll work hand in hand with Strategy, as well as Copy, Design, Social and Production, to understand the audience, cultural context, role of each channel and each stage of the funnel, and translate that thinking into strong creative.
This isn’t purely an art direction role. You need to be able to come up with strong campaign ideas, build on other people’s ideas and turn them into something bigger.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong global campaign ideas and creative platforms that can live across markets, channels and executions.
Partner closely with strategists from the beginning of the process, challenging and building on briefs rather than simply receiving them.
Understand the role creative plays across the full funnel, from building awareness and brand desire to communicating product benefits, driving consideration and supporting conversion.
Know when an execution needs to build the brand, when it needs to explain the product and when it simply needs to make someone want it.
Turn strategy, product benefits and consumer insights into simple, relevant creative ideas.
Build global creative platforms that have a clear central idea while leaving enough room for markets to make them culturally relevant.
Lead the visual direction of brands across product, lifestyle, talent and culture-led work.
Find interesting ways to communicate ingredients, efficacy, innovation and science without everything suddenly looking clinical.
Make products feel desirable through photography, film, CGI, design, casting, styling and storytelling.
Bring product and lifestyle together naturally, rather than creating a beautiful lifestyle campaign and remembering the product at the end.
Develop ideas around talent, creators, partnerships and cultural moments that make sense for the brand and the market.
Think beyond traditional campaign formats and identify opportunities across social, experiences, collaborations, entertainment and emerging culture.
Lead work from concept through production, keeping the original idea and level of craft intact along the way.
Present and sell creative thinking to senior clients and stakeholders across different markets.
Lead and develop multidisciplinary and international creative teams.

What we’re looking for

A Creative Director who is conceptually strong and visually sophisticated, with a portfolio that shows range.
Big campaign thinking
Ideas with a clear point of view that can become genuine global platforms, not just a collection of executions.
Strong visual taste
A great eye for photography, film, casting, styling, design and contemporary brand aesthetics.
Product storytelling
Experience making products, ingredients, technology or benefits interesting and desirable, especially when there’s real science or efficacy behind them.
Full-funnel creative thinking
An understanding of how people move from discovering a brand to considering and buying it, and how the creative job changes along the way.
Strong creative + strategy partnership
Someone who likes working closely with strategists, has a point of view on the brief and knows how to turn strategic thinking into creative opportunities.
Global thinking
Experience developing work for multiple markets and understanding the difference between a global idea and simply making the same campaign appear everywhere. You should be comfortable collaborating with local teams and adapting ideas around different cultural behaviors and audiences without losing the core creative thought.
Lifestyle and culture
Work that shows an understanding of how brands can play in culture through talent, creators, collaborations, social, entertainment and experiences.
Range

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.

Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated.
A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it.
A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.
Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas.
A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.
Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.
Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.
